lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters exhibiting a grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob spacing increasing towards the posterior caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical alignments of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct grid-like nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features visible on the upper third of the flank displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs are bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette, arranged in an irregular, sparse distribution.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of minute circular blobs on the visible pectoral fin and the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits.
